data.description:
## Context
`docs/config.md` cites obsolete ADR numbers for cross-ticket overlap and transport retry. It also says `REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW` was removed, while `src/rebar/_operation_config.py` and focused tests still read it as an enabled-by-default diagnostic switch.

## Plan
- Point cross-ticket overlap guidance to ADR 0086.
- Point transport retry guidance to ADR 0087.
- Describe `REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW` as an active diagnostic switch and state its current default and false-value behavior.
- Preserve the distinction between diagnostic snapshot composition and behavior-bearing configuration.
- Change Markdown only and do not alter the switch.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Cross-ticket overlap and transport retry links resolve to ADR 0086 and ADR 0087.
- [ ] The shadow switch is documented as active, diagnostic, and enabled by default.
- [ ] False spellings and invalid-value behavior match `shadow_enabled()`.
- [ ] No source, test, or configuration behavior changes.
- [ ] Targeted documentation index and link checks pass.
data.title: F19C correct configuration decision and diagnostic guidance
